facts.fact: On 26 August 2026 the Minister of Administrative Modernisation opened a workshop on three texts (review of the draft act on the organisation and functioning of public administration, a Public Service Charter act, and an administrative procedures simplification act in preparation), and the passage held says the reform should enshrine the once-only principle ("dites-le-nous une fois") where legal and technical conditions allow, so users need not give the same documents to several administrations; the passage does not say which of the three texts carries it, and all are bills or drafts under preparation, none in force.
facts.system: Draft administrative reform acts (organisation of public administration; administrative procedures simplification), Guinea

note: Passages only; the once-only principle is stated as something the reform should enshrine, with no instrument in force and no requirement yet, so no duty fact.
